# Machine Party Review: A Killer Party Game With One Big Catch
Jessica Gibson
Jessica Gibson Lead Systems Architect & Technical Editor | SoonLab · 2026-08-12
About 8 minutes
Machine Party Review: A Killer Party Game With One Big Catch
**Machine Party is easy to recommend to a group of three or four friends who already use voice chat.** Its 15 short, lethal minigames turn simple actions—eating peas, assembling a gun, driving a forklift—into fast rounds of bluffing, sabotage, panic, and slapstick death.

...

| Verdict | Recommended for an established group; wait if you need matchmaking or solo play |
| Players | 2–4 online players |
| Content | 15 minigames, character customization, 15 Steam achievements |
| Price | $7.99 standard price; $6.79 launch offer through August 13, 2026 |
| Best with | Four friends in Discord who enjoy short competitive sessions |

## What Is Machine Party?
[Machine Party](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108000/Machine_Party/) is a 2–4 player [online co-op horror game](https://www.soonlab.ai/blog/best-co-op-horror-games/) from Mike Klubnika and GDeavid, published by Oro Interactive. It launched on Steam on July 30, 2026.
Klubnika is best known for _Buckshot Roulette_ , and the family resemblance is immediate: low-poly faces, filthy machinery, blunt rules, heavy industrial sound, and the sense that every object in the room was designed by a hostile bureaucracy.

...

## What Players Are Saying on Steam, Reddit, X, and YouTube
* **Steam:** As of August 10, 2026, the store shows a “Very Positive” rating, with 2,502 positive and 356 negative reviews across all displayed review types. That is an encouraging launch result, especially for a multiplayer game whose value depends on repeat sessions.
